gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Santa Fe's own pump kit for the Compact70 (part 4022220) lifts water only 12 ft vertically and 20 ft in total. AlorAir's built-in pump, per AlorAir's HD35P page, lifts to 19.6 ft, so the low-profile Santa Fe still lifts less than the integrated-pump AlorAirs after you buy the add-on kit.
standout_why: Compared against: crawlspacedehumidifiers.org/with-pump (cited) says the Compact70 kit is 'sold separately' with no part number or lift. dehumidifierverdict.com (cited) says only 'Optional pump' for the Santa Fe and AprilAire units. crawlspacecosts.com (cited) prices a Santa Fe pump at $150-$200 but gives no lift, and its list of what it doesn't state includes the Santa Fe pump lift. Our own current page has the part number 4022220 but no lift. CrawlClimate (cited) could not be read: its SSL certificate failed and a curl retry was not approved. None of these pages give the maker's model list for the kit or its 12 ft vertical / 20 ft total limit.
decides: Confirms the pick. Where the drain sits higher than the unit, an AlorAir with a built-in pump (19.6 ft, stated by the maker for the HD35P) beats the Santa Fe Compact70 plus kit (12 ft vertical, 20 ft total). The Compact70 stays a choice for low clearance only when the drain is within 12 ft of rise. The page should also stop listing the HD55 and HD55S as if they share parts with the HD55P: AlorAir sells a separate HD55P-only filter.

findings.label: Maker's pump kit, its fit and its lift limit
findings.value: Condensate Pump Kit part 4022220: up to 12 ft vertical lift, 20 ft total run, 2-quart reservoir. The page lists these models as compatible: Compact70, Oasis105, Classic, Impact155, Ultra70, Ultra98, Ultra120, Ultra120V, Ultra155, Ultra205, UltraMD33.
findings.note: Read on Santa Fe's own product page. The page shows no price. It notes '*Current model does not utilize bracket.' Advance Dry110 and the Ultra V-series are not in the list, but the page doesn't say they are excluded.

findings.label: Built-in pump lift and drain hoses in the box
findings.value: 19.6 ft pump lift. Box contains a 19.6 ft water pipe, a 6.5 ft water pipe, a MERV-1 filter and the manual.
findings.source_title: AlorAir Sentinel HD35P Wi-Fi Dehumidifier – AlorAir
findings.note: The page's wording is that the pump can 'shock water to an altitude of 19.6 feet'. Also on the page: 35 pints/day AHAM, 33-105°F, 115 V/60 Hz at 2.9 A max, 15.2 × 11.2 × 11.4 in, 6-year limited warranty with the first 2 years full coverage.

findings.source_title: AlorAir Sentinel HD35P Wi-Fi Dehumidifier – AlorAir
findings.note: AlorAir's app-download page (https://www.alorair.com/app-download) describes AlorAir-C as the crawlspace/basement app and AlorAir-Lite as the restoration-unit app. It gives no supported-model list and no Wi-Fi band.

findings.source_title: AlorAir Sentinel HD35P Wi-Fi Dehumidifier – AlorAir

findings.label: Drain hoses, app and electrical
findings.value: Pump draining, with 6.56 ft and 19.60 ft hoses. 115 V/60 Hz, 4.1 A max. Runs 33.8-104°F. 6-year limited warranty, first 2 years full coverage.
findings.source_title: Alorair Sentinel HDi65S Black WIFI – AlorAir
findings.note: The maker page does not state a lift height, although rival pages say 19.6 ft. 55 pints/day AHAM, 19.2 × 12.2 × 13.3 in.

findings.label: Replacement filter fit
findings.value: MERV-1 filter sold only for the HD55P ('Compatible with: Sentinel HD55P'), $19.90. The HD55S and HDi65S share a different filter: MERV-1 at $19.90, or a MERV-8 upgrade at $19.99.
findings.source_title: Alorair 1Pack Merv-1 filter for Sentinel HD55P – AlorAir
findings.note: Cross-checked on https://www.alorair.com/category/filter-other-accessories (page 1 of 4). Page 1 lists a MERV-8 for the HD55S/HDi65S but none for the HD55P.

findings.label: Replacement filter fit
findings.value: MERV-1 filter shared across Galaxy60, 60P and 85P, $19.99
findings.note: Fit taken from the product title on AlorAir's accessory category page.
